summary: # Global Rules > **MANDATORY** — These rules apply to ALL skills. Violations are unacceptable. ## Rule 1: Destructive Actions Require User Confirmation ⛔ **ALWAYS use `ask_user`** before ANY destructive action. ### What is Destructive? | Category | Examples | |----------|----------| | **Delete** | `az group delete`, `azd down`, `rm -rf`, delete resource | | **Overwrite** | Replace existing files, overwrite config, reset settings | | **Irreversible** | Purge Key Vault, delete storage account, drop database |
